preprocessing_contract.input: Bounded 2D RGB brightfield microscopy image (TIFF, OME-TIFF, or PNG; 16x16 up to 16 MP / 4096x4096)
preprocessing_contract.pixel_size: Native 0.5 um/px; calibrated inputs differing by > 1% are bilinear-resampled (align_corners=False) to 0.5 um/px before inference and nearest-neighbour resampled back on output
preprocessing_contract.normalization: Per-channel 0.1-99.9 percentile scaling (eps=1e-3), clamped to [-2, 3], reflect-padded bottom/right to a multiple of 16
preprocessing_contract.prediction: 2D InstanSeg_UNet (m.fcn, 5 dense channels: dx, dy, sigma0, sigma1, seediness), 61-parameter ProbabilityNet over 64x64 per-seed windows, 8-connected fragment flood-fill & hole-filling, winner-takes-all pixel assignment, sparse IoMA (> 0.3) connected-component merging, and 512x512 overlap-tile stitching (overlap=80, max_cell_size=20, dual-IoU > 0.1)

source_commit: instanseg/instanseg v0.1.2 (bc36594d68e555ebd940f5917a1ce0eed6048b15) with instanseg_models_v0.1.1 brightfield_nuclei.zip (Apache-2.0), matching vnmd/instanseg_0.1.2:20261125
graph_optimization: 2D InstanSeg_UNet backbone (m.fcn) exported with dynamic height/width axes at opset 17 (Add, Concat, Constant, Conv, MaxPool, Relu, Resize) in exact float32 precision; 61-parameter ProbabilityNet and instance decoder ported to pure JS. Built by packages/instanseg/scripts/export_model.py
